name: HTML5 Video Media Element

licensing.notes: Native HTML media element supported natively in Chromium.

rendering_constraints.notes: Video assets must be pre-normalized via scripts/ingest-asset.sh to 1280x720 @ 30fps silent H.264. Must specify muted and loop attributes.

justification: Approved core technology. Used for hybrid cinematic layering (Veo/3D background underlays) placed beneath vector SVG stages.
